_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Surface tape is low-conviction chop inside the Anxiety band; absent a fear break or sharp ETF reclaim, the skilled base-rate call is hold and drift one rung toward Complacency.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicitly HOLD into Complacency; narrative is flow-descriptive only (outflow) and does not assert a directional phase break
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds ~45-55, 30d momentum stays roughly -10% to +5%, ETF flows remain flat, and price does not trend
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks below ~40 with accelerating down-momentum, or ETF flows reverse sharply higher and price reclaims a clear uptrend
